project.description: Display identity of the configured application. Labels are not authentication.

applicationVersions.description: Target application versions this definition was reviewed against.

entryPoints.description: Named launch entry points; defaults to `setup` in authoring sources.

configuration.description: Root object schema of every answer the definition collects.

outputSelector.description: Public required enum whose value picks the prepared output set.

pointers.description: Settings shown by this section; nested pointers such as `/server/domain` are allowed.
Settings in this group; each lies within one of the section's pointers.

groups.description: Collapsible groups organizing the section's settings.

presentation.description: Sections, collapsible groups and journeys. Layout never changes validation.

deployment.description: Recipe and scope selectors choosing which components and outputs apply.

localization.description: Translations of display text addressed by JSON Pointer.

title: Configurator SetupDefinition 0.0.1

title.description: Display title. When omitted, the key is humanized (`PUBLIC_BASE_URL` shows as `Public Base URL`).

description.description: Help text shown with the field.

format.description: Lexical format. Asserted formats are validated automatically; other tokens are annotations.

sensitivity.description: Custody floor. Omitted means `sensitive`; `secret` values never appear in public metadata.

initialValue.description: Public value prepared when the answer is absent. It never supplies a protected member; an object may open with absent required members, which become operator obligations.

suggestedValue.description: Public value offered to the operator but never applied automatically.

units.description: Unit label shown beside the value, for example `seconds`.

uniqueBy.description: Item-relative pointer, or pointers forming a composite key, that must be unique across list rows.

applicableWhen.description: The field is collected only while this predicate holds.

requiredWhen.description: A collected object member must be supplied while this predicate holds. It may read any answer, and the member must not also be listed in `required`.

propertyOrder.description: Display order of object members; `*` places every unlisted member. Never changes canonical identity.

order.description: Display rank among sibling members without an explicit `propertyOrder`.

placeholder.description: Example input shown in an empty editor. Never a value; public fields only.

defaultText.description: Explains what the target does when the field is omitted. Never a value.

deprecationMessage.description: Guidance for a field marked `deprecated: true`.

widget.description: Preferred editor; clients may fall back to `auto`.

syntax.description: Highlighting language for the `code` widget, for example `json`.

booleanLabels.description: Display labels for the two boolean states.

itemTitlePointer.description: Item-relative pointer of a public scalar that titles each list row.

displayRawKey.description: Shows the exact key instead of the humanized title.

secret.description: Secret kind, acquisition, encoding, constraints and local generation.

guidance.description: Operator instructions, public HTTPS links and search terms.

choices.description: Metadata for a subset of `enum` members; unlabeled values are humanized.

x-configurator.description: Configurator semantics: sensitivity, guidance, choices, ordering, widgets and applicability.

description: Bounded recursive structure. Admission checks exact numbers, Unicode, acyclic local references, discriminators, privacy, computed capabilities and resource limits; unsupported semantics reject.
